rows.label: tlk70000022_02_msg0001
rows.name:
The power of that Blade, Metsu... It
was extraordinary.

rows.label: tlk70000022_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Just thinking that he's still out
there unchecked sends a chill down my
spine!

rows.label: tlk70000022_02_msg0003
rows.name:
It seems humans will have to manage
and control Blades after all.

rows.label: tlk70000022_02_msg0004
rows.name:
The old age of coexistence is over.
Unless we change how we respond, Iira
has no future.
